sentiment.rationale: Full-year 2023 organic revenue guidance was raised from 6% to 8%, and core constant currency EPS growth guidance was raised from 8% to 9%. The raise is attributed to better-than-expected elasticities and productivity, not one-time items or FX. Management expressed confidence in the outlook, though noted some remaining uncertainties (consumer trajectory, geopolitics, certain currencies). This constitutes a meaningful upward revision to forward guidance, warranting a score of +0.50.

summary.revenue: Reported net revenue of $17,846 million, up 10.2% year-over-year. Organic revenue growth was 14.3%.
summary.eps: Reported diluted EPS of $1.40, down 54% year-over-year. Core EPS of $1.50, up 18% on a constant currency basis.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2023 organic revenue growth now expected to be 8% (previously 6%). Core constant currency EPS growth now expected to be 9% (previously 8%). Implied 2023 core EPS of $7.27 (previously $7.20).
summary.margin: Core gross margin grew 89 basis points. Core operating margin grew 47 basis points.
key_risks: Uncertainty about consumer trajectory in the second half of 2023
Geopolitical risks that could impact the business
Currency volatility in certain emerging and developing markets (e.g., Argentina, Turkey, Egypt)
Potential need for additional pricing in highly inflationary markets
Private label growth in some categories, though from a low base
key_opportunities: Strong consumer demand and resilient categories globally
Improving operational metrics (labor availability, material flow, transportation)
Innovation and brand building driving market share gains (e.g., Frito-Lay gaining share at fastest pace in ~10 years)
Pepsi Zero Sugar reformulation performing well (60% growth in Q1)
Expansion into adjacent categories (e.g., low alcohol, Cheetos Mac and Cheese)
Strong performance in China with consumer optimism

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO Ramon Laguarta stated, 'We are very pleased with our performance and business momentum as our categories and geographies remained resilient during the first quarter,' and the company raised full-year guidance, indicating confidence in the outlook.
